record.field: one work item per person, not per message. It stores no message bodies; it points at the Zalo thread, the call log and the lead, and composes the timeline when you open it.

a deterministic number, not an opinion. Six terms add up: needs-reply 40, booking within 24h 30, unread 15, unhandled missed call 10, watch phrase 15, plus one point per whole hour of waiting up to 20.
taking ownership of a conversation so nobody else replies at the same time. One winner only; if two people claim together, the second is told who won.
the geography an operator works. It keeps a Hà Nội desk out of a Hồ Chí Minh City inbox. For channel traffic it is derived from the channel account the message arrived on.
traffic wins over declaration. If real messages arrived on Zalo, the channel is Zalo, even if the lead form said “phone”. A declared channel is only used when there is no traffic yet.
the clinic's verified Zalo identity that patients message. One OA per catchment area.
a term that, if it appears in an inbound message, adds 15 to urgency. It is triage, never a severity judgement: it moves the item up the list, it does not diagnose.
one recorded arrival from the website: the page, the referrer, and the UTM/click ids. A person can have several before they ever message you.
the tags on an ad link (source, medium, campaign) that say which advert brought someone. Without them the visit lands in “Unmatched campaigns”.
the client's recorded permission to discuss their health information with a named other person. It has states (draft / active / withdrawn / expired) and it is checked, not assumed.
handing a contact to the Head Nurse, the Operations Manager or the Duty Doctor. It needs a lead on the conversation, and it pages a real clinician.
something arrived on a channel with too little information to become a conversation. It records exactly what came in and cannot be edited; you convert it or dismiss it.
marking a contact as spam also flags its phone number for the future, so the same number is pre-judged the next time it calls.
